meta.title: Mylder: live map of Copenhagen
meta.description: Copenhagen's buses, S-tog, metro and trains on one live map, honest about how fresh each position is.

about.title: About Mylder
about.description: A live map of Copenhagen's buses, S-tog, Metro and trains, honest about how fresh each position is.
about.honest: Mylder shows the data as Rejseplanen sends it, in its own words and language, and marks every figure it works out itself.
about.nonCommercial: Mylder is non-commercial: no advertising, no paid tier, and no sale of the data or of anything built on it.

credits.title: Data and credits
credits.transit: Realtime data and the timetable: {rejseplanen}, under {licence}. Timetable of {date}.
credits.delays: Delays and cancellations: {company}, through Rejseplanen's SIRI-ET.
credits.buildings: Building heights come from OpenStreetMap and are approximate.
credits.recording: The planes are recorded adsb.lol data, open under the same licence in {recordings}.
credits.style: The map's style is a fork of OpenFreeMap's Positron, itself from OpenMapTiles' Positron GL Style: see {licence}.

states.title: Data states
states.live: The vehicle itself reported this position within about the last two polls.
states.ageing: The vehicle's last report is older than that but under 5 minutes; the dot moves on from it along the line.
states.estimated: No recent report, but Rejseplanen still has the trip: a position it computed, or expected times.
states.timetableOnly: No realtime for this trip today, so it is placed from the timetable. Every Metro train is.
states.noSignal: The trip had realtime, and it stopped 5 minutes ago or more; the dot moves on the timetable and its last delay.
